seo.title: AI chatbot for hotels and travel businesses | Steps AI
seo.description: Answer guest and traveller questions, capture booking enquiries and hand over to your team on WhatsApp, Instagram and your website.

hero.body: Travellers ask about rooms, packages, timings and policies at all hours. Your agent answers from your information, captures enquiries and passes bookings to your team.
hero.reassurance: Answers any time. Enquiries saved. Your team confirms the booking.

goodToKnow.title: Good to know
items: Steps AI does not connect to hotel booking engines. Your team confirms availability and bookings.

items.q: Can the agent confirm a room booking?
items.a: It collects the enquiry and passes it to your team, who confirm availability.

problems.title: Where bookings slip away, and what your agent does about it.
problems.intro: Travellers ask before they book, at all hours, and often book wherever answers first.

items.scene: A family plans a trip at night. Nobody answers, so they book elsewhere.
items.fix: Your agent answers rooms, amenities and policies at any hour from your information.
items.reply: Yes, breakfast is included with every room.

items.scene: Dates but no guest count. A name but no phone.
items.fix: Your agent collects dates, guests and contact details before passing it to your team.
items.reply: Happy to check. How many guests, and your name and phone?

items.scene: Your best customers never hear about the monsoon offer.
items.fix: Send an approved WhatsApp template to past guests, and your agent answers every reply.
items.ask: Is the monsoon offer still on?
items.reply: Yes, until 30 August. Want me to note your dates?
